metadata_adapter: AST extracts word/train_rows/compare/copy_replay/allograph_replay/boundary_replay only. Avoids metadata.py import and therefore avoids its corpus import. A readonly JSON loader and independent scalar model are supplied.
training_adapter: Clone saved train+legacy pages, set each effective_hands slot to original page H, then assert word/hand/position projection equals saved frozen allograph train records.
score_adapter: Expose original positive-cost arrays under inline__ aliases to the independent metadata helper. No original arrays overwritten.
position_changes: Read caller supplied packet rows/scores and position conditions
Convert positive base/H costs to log probabilities with explicit minus signs
Read saved null arrays under packet position/
Use math.fsum for every permutation rather than only first twenty
paragraph_changes: Instantiate saved probability tables with independent replay, reconstruct selected prefix posteriors from saved training counts and all four selected costs on saved paragraph targets. No confirm-specific reader invoked.

first_attempt.reason: Duplicate targets keyword while assembling paragraph report, after probability calculation. No statistical mismatch.
